agent_types.CoordinatorAgent: Responsible for managing and coordinating the actions of other agents to achieve system-wide goals.
agent_types.SensorAgent: Collects data from the environment and provides it to other agents for processing and decision-making.
agent_types.DecisionAgent: Analyzes data and makes decisions to guide the actions of the system towards its objectives.
agent_types.ActuatorAgent: Executes actions in the environment based on decisions made by the DecisionAgent.
agent_types.CommunicationAgent: Facilitates communication and information exchange between agents to ensure effective collaboration.
